name: rsmdt/the-startup
description: A startup plugin with skills, commands, and agents for deep-research analysis, archiving, and brainstorming. The verified sample is a deep-research analysis orchestrator that requires cited claims and independent skeptic verification, producing one cited report.
install: /plugin marketplace add rsmdt/the-startup then /plugin install start@the-startup. Plugin route only. Do not use the README pipe installer for install.sh.
